source: foldkit-117 (filed as foldkit-17064): examples/websocket-chat managedResources.chatSocket.acquire returns Effect.callback<WebSocket, Error>; replacing the raw socket with a platform service removes that call, while the native acquire writes its original Error channel.
before:
import { Effect } from 'effect'
export const managedResources = () => ({ chatSocket: { acquire: () => Effect.callback<number, Error>(resume => { resume(Effect.fail(new Error('Failed to connect to WebSocket'))) }) } })
after: export const managedResources = () => ({ chatSocket: { acquire: effect (): number!Error => (effect { throw new Error('connect'); }) catch effect (error) => { throw new Error('Failed to connect to WebSocket'); } } })
marker: throw new Error('Failed to connect to WebSocket')
